message: TDD implementation complete. Added _is_system_injected_field() helper function with prefix matching support. Both TaskFlowValidationStrategy and GraphAIValidationStrategy now properly skip validation for nested system-injected fields like user_input.query and project.name. Coverage 98.08% (exceeds 90% target). All 50 body_template_validator tests pass, all 119 jobGeneratorV2 tests pass (no regressions).
